test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 14 Oct, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: A rectangular sheet of paper of length 10π cm and width 5 cm is rolled along its length (width of the sheet becomes the height of the cylinder) to form a cylinder. What would be the radius of the cylinder?
solution:
**Given:**

Length of the rectangular sheet = 10π cm

Width of the rectangular sheet = 5 cm

**Formula Used:**

Radius of the cylinder, r = frac{{Length of the rectangular sheet}}{2π}

**Calculation:**

When the sheet is rolled along its length to form a cylinder, the length of the sheet becomes the circumference of the base of the cylinder. So,

Circumference = 2πr

 10π = 2πr

⇒ 10 = 2r

⇒ r = 10/2

⇒ r = 5 cm

**The radius of the cylinder is 5 cm.**
